annotation.title_en: Hiroshima Process International Guiding Principles for Advanced AI system
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Commission, DG CONNECT (G7 Hiroshima AI Process)
annotation.summary_en: European Commission library page for the G7 Hiroshima Process International Guiding Principles for organizations developing advanced AI systems (30 Oct 2023). A non-exhaustive, living, voluntary set of principles building on the OECD AI Principles, targeting foundation models and generative AI. Only the landing description is shown; the full principles are in a download.
key_provisions_or_claims: Guiding principles promote safe, secure and trustworthy AI worldwide
Targets organizations developing advanced AI, including foundation models and generative AI
Builds on OECD AI Principles as a living, non-exhaustive document
Applies to all AI actors across design, development, deployment and use
Accompanied by a voluntary Code of Conduct for AI developers
